description: The file defines a SwiftUI view 'HomeToolbar' for a custom toolbar component in an iOS application, along with several nested subviews such as 'HomeToolbarStatusButton' and 'HomeToolbarActionButton'. It manages UI elements and interactions related to home toolbar functionalities.

classes.name: HomeToolbar
classes.description: A SwiftUI View representing the main home toolbar with status and action buttons.

classes.name: HomeToolbarStatusButton
classes.description: A SwiftUI View for the status indicator button with pulsing animation based on connection status.

classes.name: HomeToolbarActionButton
classes.description: A SwiftUI View for individual action buttons within the toolbar, with configurable appearance and behavior.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Computed property defining the view hierarchy and layout for 'HomeToolbar' and nested views.

methods.name: updatePulse
methods.description: Method to manage pulsing animation state based on connection status and scene phase.
